author: AiriLife-ai
description: KiraAI runtime control console: a small set of merged LLM tools to inspect and hot-manage plugins, skills, providers, MCP, sessions, personas, configs, logs and the plugin store - with whitelist/blacklist access control, risk levels, automatic backups, an audit trail and a full WebUI panel.

zh.description: 给 KiraAI 的运行自控台：用合并后的少量工具统一查看与热管理插件、技能、Provider、MCP、会话、人设、配置、日志与插件商店；带白/黑名单访问控制、风险分级、自动备份、审计留痕与完整 WebUI 面板。
